start.text: (Halfway down the corridor, the phone in Ravi's pocket buzzes. The screen says APPA.)

appa1.text: Appa: Ravi? Sorry, sorry, I know it's late. Your Amma's in the hospital again - no, don't come, it's nothing, it's the sugar. I just wanted to hear you.

appa2.text: Ravi: I'm at work, Appa. I'll call in the morning.

appa3.text: Appa: Eat something. You sound thin. (The line stays open a second longer, as if he had one more thing to say.)
